QuestInfo.name: Kiku's Fourth Training Session
QuestInfo.0: Visit #b#p1102000# the Training Instructor#k and receive some training.
QuestInfo.1: #p1102000#'s fourth session involves facing off against the fourth weakest... you get the drill. Anyway, an easy Mimi called #r#o0100123##k, and defeating #r20#k of them in the process. You better hunt down those #o0100123#s in #b#m130010100##k. \n\n#o0100123##r #a200061##k

0.0: 네 번째 수련은... 이제 말 안 해도 알겠지? 지금 네 레벨이면 딱 사냥하기 좋을 #m0100123#를 잡으면 돼. 이번에는 한 20마리 잡아 보자고.

yes.0: #m0100123#가 있는 위치... 설명 안 해도 짐작하겠지? 수련의 숲3에서 포탈을 타고 왼쪽으로 나가면 수련의 숲4가 있는데, 그곳에 #m0100123#들이 있어. 자, 그럼 수고해.

no.0: 벌써 수련이 지겨워진 거야? 이봐이봐. 아직 멀었다고. 기사의 길은 이 정도가 아니라니까.

0.0: Your fourth training session will involve... you know what I'm going to give you, right? You are right at that level where you can take on #r#o0100123##k. Let's try #r20#k of them, okay?

yes.0: I don't even need to tell you where you can find #o0100123#... Right? Find them at or near #b#m130010100##k. Good luck.

no.0: Are you already getting sick of training? You can't say that. You're nowhere near the level you should be to even think of something like that.

1.0: You must have defeated 20 #o0100123#s. Wow... a little more, and you may be able to become a Knight-in-Training! I advise you to start planning out what kind of a knight you'd like to become. A knight of light, a magician of fire, a bowman of wind, a thief of darkness, or a pirate of lightning... you're surely interested in becoming one of them, right?

yes.0: But before anything, you must become stronger. Talk to me when you're ready to take the next step.

mob.0: Were you not able to defeat #r20 #o0100123#s#k yet? You'll find them at #b#m130010100##k or in forests nearby.
